Can barely get anyone to play with me from the discord. No private matchmaking and randoms are worse than bots. The game's on the gamepass and people play the game like they've never touched a video game before. Until this gets private match making, I can't play this without waiting for my human teammates to kill themselves and immediately quit on being downed.

How bad is it? If you've played left for dead, you know medkits, guns, and throwables? People from gamepass will choose one to pick up, or none of them. I have had a random charge out of spawn with the basic pistol, die immediately and leave. The game isn't bad, and the only problem I have with it currently is that I have to burn my retinas to kill one of the special infected (Flasher, basically a mobile flash bang) but the PC community is basically dead and waiting for the next content. Don't buy unless you had 3 other people you can communicate with on voice.

[h1]6,9/10[/h1]
New another version of the  left 4 dead and again not very successful, at least for now.
The game is now very alpha, and I’m not taking about huge ping, the main disadvantage here is that it’s boring to shoot here, just boring, there is no impact from shooting, from hits too, only shooting from a pistol is more or less normal, but the animation of his reloading is a real buzz, but you will practically not use the pistol.
Also, although conceptually interesting, but very little detailed locations. The color contrast in the game is very grey, even on the surface. The campaign is only 3 hours, the 3rd chapter of which is a reskin of the first. The animations for the Special Infected are just terrible and lopsided so far.
Even apart from all this, there are significant disadvantages:
1. The terribly dark soundtrack of the game, starting with the music of the menu, it drives you straight into some kind of depression, if you don’t turn it off, then it’s sickening to play, although in the middle there was some attempt at a cheerful soundtrack like Deathloop.
2. There is no plot and it is unlikely to appear. But this was also the main disadvantage of the original left 4 dead game. There is practically no lore in the game, although there seems to be a whole space station here.

So does this mod give us left 4 dead`s fans anything?
Well, in general, the idea of ​​replacing zombies with aliens always appealed to me, but the boss designs here are very bad, but they came up with a new blind boss, which is cool. The spitting critters are copied from Deed Space and they are not so good. And, in general, we could shoot aliens earlier in the Earthfall game, and there they are even cooler.
There are cool grenades, indeed, at least some kind of innovation.
There is an interesting mechanics of a portable flask, when it heats up in your hands and you have to throw it to a friend in his still cold hands, this is really really cool mechanics that adds co-op, but it's all one little thing. MORE THINGS ARE NEEDED LIKE THIS!! 

In general, this is still an ordinary mod for redesigning the left 4 dead in a different setting, even the recent Back 4 Blood was a little better, not very good either, but for me it became the most successful copy of the left 4 dead. Will this game be able to become a really good spiritual successor of Left 4 dead, which we all have been waiting for so long?, well.. at least by 7.3/10, I don’t even know.. I think there are still chances, but small.
p.s. Please bring back the ability to run!!)

reviews.review:
The game is still *very* early access, but it has some serious promise and is already quite fun.

Anacrusis is a horde shooter ala Left 4 Dead or World War Z, but it has a very unique visual style, leaning heavily into campy, 80s sci-fi aesthetics. The star mechanic is the matter compiler, which will offer each player a choice of 3 perks if found.

Early Access: No private parties, and some uncommunicative players can diminish the experience but the gameplay, so far, is more than enough to make up for it. It's fast, sometimes frantic and often frustrating when the AI Director decides to go from 0 to 100 in seconds but very satisfying when you do make it.

Weapons are... present. There's a very limited variety of three base guns and two "Tertiary" guns so things do get repetitive fast in that regard. The SMB seems to be the all-purpose "go-to" though depending on what perks you find from Matter Compilers along the way, the Plasma Rifle can get a fair innings too. There's no Melee ability: you have instead a pulse shield that can repel enemies, though it's a coin toss sometimes as to whether or not it kills them. Grenades are abundant, fun to use and (somehow) have more variants than the base weapons. Vortex Grenades and Stasis Grenades are great. Incendiary, Impact and Goo? Still struggling to find a good way to use them.

The movement is good, though the inability to sprint leaves me wanting. Enemies can and will spawn literally right behind you (though never in your field of vision) and it would be nice to be able to put some distance between them and the player without using the pulse carelessly. Especially since the pulse doesn't push enemies back that far.

My biggest gripe with the game so far is it's engine. UE4 is janky with it's physics so you often see enemy bodies flying off into space or floating gracefully to the floor in ways that defy gravity. The inability to turn many settings off (merely to "Low") makes my relatively old PC struggle with some of the faster scenes, to the point of 4/5 FPS. This is even with my editing the Engine.ini files to strip out all the garbage like Motion Blur and Bloom. This is a shooter at heart: I want precision, not beauty.

The Music and staging seem great. It's hard to hear the former over to screeching of enemies and you'll be far to busy trying to survive in the crescendos to pay much attention. Likewise the Level design seems solid, with a clear aesthetic for every area. That said, as a first time player, I did struggle to pathfind my way around. I knew where I had to go, but there is very little directional aids to tell me how to get there. Several times a swarm was called while I was looking around for a route not yet taken.

TL:DR: Good game, Frustratingly hard at times, Play with friends not randos, Engine needs more refining.

I may revisit this review once the game is out of early access, but it's a recommend so far.

Pretty fun co-op game with a very responsive development team. Really good example of a game with a lot of complex tactics while still being accessible to new players.

The game is designed really smartly never to overwhelm you with choice — for example, you can find character upgrades, but rather than choosing from a massive list like in some games, you are only given 3 options at a time. And there is very little filler or padding when it comes to your choices. Every different upgrade, weapon, or item is substantially different from the alternative.

Just keep your expectations reasonable. This is still a game made by a small studio being sold for a fraction of what most mainstream games go for. That being said, I think it's well worth the money if you enjoy co-op horde shooters.

Absolutely love this game, remind me a bit like The Amazing Eternals that unfortunately was put on "pause" (-_-). Anyways, I love the retro sci-fi 70s, some of the maps, and gameplay. The game is pretty iffy at the moment, so it best to wait until it gets into a beta phase or fully polished. I'm definitely looking forward to all the new content that stray bombay has in store in the future, I'm thinking of playing this game long term aside from killing floor 2. If you're a left 4 dead fan or a mod that like to create skins for weapons and characters, I think you might like this game for its unique designs and aesthetic nature. I definitely recommend this game to my friends.

The best way I can describe this game is if in an alternate reality Left4Dead had a sequel that went to space rather than introducing melee weapons. Unlike other 4-player co-op shooters like Back4Blood, this more accurately captures the casual pace of Left4Dead. You can definitely fail if you don't work as a team but it's relaxed enough that you can chat while you play.

My main issue with the game at this point is the lack of private lobbies but that hasn't been too big of an issue yet. That said, there are also a few annoying bugs like sometimes being unable to move/shoot or the camera getting locked in one direction after reviving. Those issues have the potential to spoil a 10-15m run but thankfully I haven't had them happen to me that much yet.

If you really like Left4Dead (especially the first game) and have three friends to co-op with I'd definitely recommend it. If you're more interested in single player, you'll probably want to hold off until first-class singleplayer support is added (you can play singleplayer with console commands or sometimes get all bots in a lobby but neither option is ideal).
Excellent co-op shooter that multiplies how great it is every major update. Most definitely the best coop shooter on the market currently. Boris protects.

Can't recommend this until they fix some special enemies.
Specifically the Flasher, who's purpose is to obstruct the player's view by turning the brightness up to infinity. Like a flash bang but permanent until you kill it.
Unlike the boomer from l4d, who has a similar ability by puking on the player and making it hard to see. You can simply melee the boomer away and avoid the puke.
The Flasher however has no queue indicating that it spawned, it spawns already active, and the only way to stop it is to shoot blindly at whatever shape you can make out.
I've stated that there's no counterplay in the official discord but everyone just says to get close to it and you can see it easier... Yeah that's not doable when you literally can't see anything.
I really wanted to like this game, the space colony setting is interesting. 
They have a lot of work to do until it's free of frustrations.
reviews.developer_response: Just wanted to let you know that we've updated the Flasher visual effect with Update 4  so it should be significantly less bright. We've also made the new, less-intense version the default for all players. It still adds chaos to the battlefield though!
